system.description:
You can sense the presence of danger naturally, giving you and edge even when you fail to spot trouble the first time.

Prerequisite: Zabrak

Effect: Whenever you reroll a Perception check and take the second result, if your second result is lower than your first result, you gain a temporary Force Point. This Force Point can be spent only to add to the result of a Perception check, and if it is not spent before the end of the encounter, it is lost.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Rebellion Era Campaign Guide
